messages.content: 計算需要多少加侖的油漆才能塗一面寬度為20英尺，高度為12英尺的牆壁，假設每加侖可覆蓋約350平方英尺。不包括15平方英尺的窗戶面積。

function.name: paint_requirement_calculate
function.description: Calculate the amount of paint required to paint a given area. Account for coverage efficiency of the paint and exclusions (like windows). Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

width.description: The width of the area to be painted in feet.

height.description: The height of the area to be painted in feet.

paint_coverage.description: Coverage area per gallon of the paint in square feet.

type.description: The type of the exclusion e.g window, door etc.

area.description: The area of the exclusion in square feet.

exclusion.description: Area not to be painted. Default to not use any exclusion if not specified.

message.reasoning:
We need to calculate paint requirement using the tool. Provide arguments accordingly.

Area: width=20 ft, height=12 ft -> total area = 240 sq ft. Exclude 15 sq ft window. Paint coverage 350 sqft/gallon. Compute gallons needed: (total_area - excluded) / coverage. That's (240-15)/350 =225/350 ≈0.642857... Gallons. Usually round up to nearest quarter or half? But question likely expects calculation result maybe 1 gallon? Actually typical answer might say about 0.65 gallons; but you would buy at least one gallon. So we can compute exactly then mention rounding up.

Let's call function with parameters:

area {width:20,height:12}
paint_coverage:350
exclusion{type:"window",area:15}

Return from function will give numeric value. Then respond.
